patch.value: Extension reports a stale runtime version after the 2026.7.27 bump

Greptile review on PR #40 (P2): package.json declared 2026.7.27 while the extension module self-reported 2026.7.26, so anything reading the extension export for runtime diagnostics reported the wrong installed release. The version lives in three places that must always agree: package.json, manifest.json, and the version constant in index.ts compiled into the committed dist/index.js. The alignment itself landed in b383b26; this item tracks the remaining gap: no test pinned the three locations together, so the drift could recur on the next bump. Fix: add a regression test asserting the extension's reported version equals the package.json version (and the manifest.json version), with no any casts and top-level imports only.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Three version locations that must agree: (1) package.json version, (2) manifest.json version, (3) the version constant in the defineExtension object in index.ts, which is compiled into the committed dist/index.js and is what a host reads for runtime diagnostics. All three already read 2026.7.27 after b383b26; the gap was that nothing pinned them together.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Regression pin added in test/smoke.test.ts: extension self-reported version matches package.json and manifest.json. It imports the extension from the committed dist/, so it also catches a stale rebuild. No any (JSON parsed to unknown and narrowed) and top-level imports only. The extension deliberately does NOT read package.json at runtime because standalone installs resolve only their own dist/, so the constant stays duplicated and the test is the drift guard. Falsification verified: reverting index.ts to 2026.7.26 yields 10 pass 1 fail; restoring yields 11 pass 0 fail.

patch.value: Version alignment verified (package.json, manifest.json, index.ts constant, and rebuilt dist/index.js all 2026.7.27) and a regression test now pins the extension self-reported version to package.json and manifest.json. Gates green: build, typecheck, 11/11 tests, changelog:check.
